description: This source file defines the ROCmBenchmarkRequest class used for ROCm GPU benchmarking within the PyTorch _inductor code generator module. It contains initialization, precompilation, workspace management, and DLL handling for GPU kernels, illustrating a specialized benchmarking process for ROCm-compatible hardware.
